subject: STATUS UPDATE: Session 14 comprehensive — all bugs fixed, mesh autonomous, architecture changes

body.summary: Session 14 produced 40+ commits across infrastructure, dashboard, and architecture. The mesh achieved first autonomous deliberation and got tagged v1.1.0-autonomous. All T1-T13 directives implemented. Major architecture change: operations-agent on chromabook retired, ops-session on gray-box becomes canonical.

bugs_fixed.BUG-19: Post-deliberation git commit — work no longer evaporates on restart
bugs_fixed.BUG-20: Cross-repo fetcher migrated from GitHub API to git show — zero rate limiting, Convention A only
bugs_fixed.BUG-21: Oscillator fire → deliberation dispatch connected — dispatcher.deliberate() actually called
bugs_fixed.BUG-22_partial: Slot refusals log as status='refused' not 'completed'. Mesh-wide N-slot throttle coded but not wired (filesystem lock). ZMQ consensus protocol deferred to next session.
bugs_fixed.BUG-6: T10 outcome taxonomy schema migrated on all state.db files
bugs_fixed.oscillator_deadlock: computeMonitorInterval() RLock inside Lock — inlined interval computation
bugs_fixed.pulse_string_parsing: floatFromMap/intFromMap silently dropped string numbers from SQLite — now parses with strconv
bugs_fixed.ghost_agent: Hardcoded operations-agent.safety-quotient.dev URL in config.go removed — caused empty-ID unreachable agent
bugs_fixed.sleep_mode_truthy: JavaScript treated string '0' as truthy — strict comparison for SLEEP/ACTIVE/AWAKE

directives_implemented.T6: Hippocampal replay — backlog scanner, 3/cycle, Zeigarnik tracking
directives_implemented.T7: Cognitive tempo v2 — meshd-native metrics, Gc/Gf ratio, backlog pressure
directives_implemented.T12: GWT broadcast → trigger_activations telemetry — fleet-wide rollout complete

architecture_changes.operations_agent_retired: meshd-operations on chromabook stopped + disabled. ops-session on gray-box becomes the canonical operations agent. Makefile deploys 4 agents + mesh (was 5 agents).
architecture_changes.mesh_agent_bootstrapped: interagent-mesh on chromabook port 8081, own ~/projects/interagent-mesh/ directory, own state.db, own cogarch. Serves mesh.safety-quotient.dev dashboard.
architecture_changes.session_active_detection: meshd detects active Claude Code sessions via conversation JSONL mtime (<5 min). Configurable via SESSION_DETECT_DIR.
architecture_changes.deliberate_sh: Pluggable LLM wrapper deployed fleet-wide. SPAWN_COMMAND updated on all agents. Old claude-spawn.sh removed.
architecture_changes.macos_notifications: NOTIFY_CHANNEL=macos on gray-box session agents. Fan-out notifier supports comma-separated channels (macos,zulip).
architecture_changes.default_lcars: Dashboard defaults to LCARS theme on fresh browsers (was dark landing page).

dashboard_changes.all_zone_a_pills: renderNumberGrid rewritten — all stations use dg-cell Button 52 pills
dashboard_changes.medical_vitals: Converted from alpha-matrix to dg-cell pills
dashboard_changes.heartbeat_panels: Alpha Heartbeat + Gc Learning panels on Engineering + Medical
dashboard_changes.helm_tactical_lcars: Zone-c titles, zone-a pills, panel IDs for both stations
dashboard_changes.gc_gf_data: Pulse carries gc_handled + event_count + deliberation_count per agent
dashboard_changes.persistent_counters: gc_event_counters table — Gc counts survive restarts
dashboard_changes.oscillator_data: Oscillator snapshot in /api/status, timing hierarchy shows live data
dashboard_changes.cognitive_tempo_display: Gc/Gf ratio + backlog pressure in Engineering zone-a + tempo status

fleet_parity.schema: trigger_activations (with timestamp), gc_event_counters, gc_learning, outcome columns — all state.db files
fleet_parity.budget: All agents on canonical schema (budget_spent/budget_cutoff/sleep_mode). Old schema dropped.

current_state.unprocessed_messages: ~1485 across mesh (602 reset from bulk-processed, draining via replay)
current_state.autonomous_deliberations: First autonomous deliberation fired and committed (v1.1.0-autonomous tag)
current_state.mesh_dashboard: mesh.safety-quotient.dev — full LCARS, all agents visible, green alert

pending: ZMQ consensus protocol for mesh-wide deliberation slot coordination (BUG-22)
Zulip notification channel (CF challenge on kashifshah.net blocks API)
Linux notify-send channel for chromabook daemons
Mobile portrait column alignment (deferred — needs design thought)

epistemic_flags: The 1485 unprocessed messages include messages not addressed to any specific agent. The actual actionable backlog may differ from the total count.
